fields.name: reason
fields.description: `"steam_auth_failed"`: Steam did not accept the ticket, or the check had an error. `"steam_link_failed"`: the server could not save the Steam id to the account and the character.

fields.name: stage
fields.description: The step that failed. `steam_auth_failed` always has `"verify_ticket"`. `steam_link_failed` has `"persist_saved_id"` (a Steam id that the account had) or `"persist_verified_ticket"` (a new Steam id from the ticket).

senders.what: `verify_tauri_steam_auth`: the save of a known Steam id fails.
`verify_tauri_steam_auth`: Steam does not accept the ticket.
`verify_tauri_steam_auth`: the save of a new Steam id fails.
